why_it_fails: The owners' ruling merge-after-green already answers it: a reviewed pull request with green checks is merged by the agent, so the owner's press could only repeat the ruling.

card.title: Merge the invoice screen change?
card.context: The change that adds a print button to the invoice screen is finished. A separate review agent read it and signed off, and all required checks passed on the final version. Merging puts it into the next release.
card.question: Should I merge the print button change now?

choices.label: Merge it
choices.pros: clinics get the print button in the next release
choices.cons: a small chance of a bug we fix in the following release

choices.label: Wait
choices.cons: clinics keep printing from the browser menu

card.why: It was reviewed and every check passed.

rulings.name: merge-after-green
rulings.text: An agent merges its own pull request once a separate review agent has signed off and the required checks are green. The owners never review or merge pull requests themselves.

rulings.name: no-weekend-deploys
rulings.text: Nothing is released to customers between Friday 6 pm and Monday 8 am, whoever asks.
